Identify the highest non-NA proportion with lowest coefficient of variance

filterPresenceCV.Rd

Identify the highest non-NA proportion with lowest coefficient of variance

Usage

filterPresenceCV(pPresent, cv, naTolerance)

Arguments

pPresent

Non-NA proportions for a metabolite across methods

cv

Coefficient of variance for a metabolite across methods

naTolerance

The absolute acceptable non-NA proportion difference below with to pick the lowest cv.

Value

The index of the row with least NAs or, if non-NA proportions are within naTolerance, the row with lowest CV

Details

This function requires that the input pPresent vector is sorted in descending order. The between proportion differences are classified as being above or below the naTolerance. If the first difference, always between the top two highest proportions when inputs are sorted, is larger than naTolerance, it returns 1 since the biggest pPresent exceeds the tolerance. Otherwise it returns the lowest coefficient of variance among the values with difference less than naTolerance. The indexing with which() works since diff returns a vector with one less than the input.
